messages:
gina: quick dump  onboarding Sable-11b (int4) on Dedicated. seeing repeatable memory cliff during mixed warmup (short chats + one long >2k token generation). small rouge dip on long docs. sharing repro + initial mitigation thoughts.

pete: paste the runner snippet and a minimal repro please.

gina: runner (trimmed):
```
model: sable-11b-int4
batch_target: auto
max_new_tokens: 220
kv_prefetch: full
slot_compactor_interval: 60s
soft_reserve: 0.10
```
repro: cold hosts, 12 short chats (~120 tokens) then a single long summarize (~2300 tokens). node drops to ~3% free slots -> transient OOM -> compactor reclaims ~550MiB and recovers.

yara: allocator lines?

gina: logs:
```
[2026-03-25T03:05:12Z] gpu_alloc failed 1.12GiB
[2026-03-25T03:05:13Z] kv_live=3.9GiB
[2026-03-25T03:05:15Z] free_slot_frac=0.03
[2026-03-25T03:05:18Z] compactor reclaimed=560MiB
```

mike: two safe levers: 1) lower max_new_tokens default to 48 for this quant variant, 2) set kv_prefetch_window=256 and enable kv_trim when active_gen > 512 with trim_ratio=0.25. also try batch_pacing_ms=45 for warmup hosts.

eva: propose canary plan: roll the config to 5% Dedicated, enable compact_interval=25s, batch_pacing_ms=45, max_new_tokens=48, kv_prefetch_window=256. run summarization eval (130 long examples) + perf sweep (p50/p95). alert if memory cushion <256MiB or ROUGE delta >0.7.

gina: opening PR and canary now. will post eval results here in ~3-4 hours.

devops-bot: :gear: canary applied  sable-11b-int4 -> 5% dedicated canary. ChangeSet: infra/2026-sable-int4-01. PR: #2031 created by gina.

pete: thanks  i'll wire the eval harness and compare logs vs FP32 baseline. ping when results in.

gina: will do. updating thread with results and any followups. :mag:
